patch_description: Reorganizes the search as a feedback-driven frontier: repaired candidates seed a diverse archive, and short batched neighborhoods are explored from archive members chosen using both solution quality and visit history. Each neighborhood prioritizes bottleneck-relieving switches, then mixes surrogate-ranked proposals with diverse alternatives. Adaptive parent selection shifts toward less-visited regions after repeated stalls, while bounded move generation and small batches leave more of the LP budget for trying different regions.
